dimension_4.justification: The document displays an exemplary specification structure with strict schema formatting, unique numbering (US-001 to US-006), and clear MoSCoW prioritization (P0, P1, P2). Each user story contains atomic, testable acceptance criteria written in Given/When/Then format, complemented by a formal state machine defining states, allowed mutations, transitions, guards, and side effects. dimension_5.justification: The non-functional requirements are comprehensive and production-ready, establishing explicit quantitative latency targets (e.g., marketplace feed p95 < 80ms at 500 QPS) backed by composite and partial database indexing and Redis caching designs. Technical feasibility is actively balanced against the 4-week delivery constraint.
